# Sophia reading guide
Unofficial companion to Mingyang Sun, Feng Hong, Weinan Zhang (2025), arXiv:2512.18202v1.
Start: README.md, AGENTS.md
Source identity: metadata/paper.json; metadata/sources.json
Claims: metadata/claims.json
Pilot observations only: metadata/results.json
Concepts and glossary: docs/01-concepts-and-context.md
Architecture, notation, routines: docs/02-architecture-and-learning.md
Pilot setup, figures, discrepancies: docs/03-pilot-and-evidence.md
Evidence boundaries and limitations: docs/04-analysis-and-limitations.md
Complete source/figure/reference map: docs/05-paper-map.md
Discussion and proposed evaluation: docs/06-discussion-and-evaluation.md
Credits and licensing: ATTRIBUTION.md, LICENSE
Research citation: CITATION.cff; references/paper.bib
Verification: VERIFICATION.md; scripts/validate_repository.py
Keep conceptual architecture separate from the single-agent pilot.
No runtime weight updates in the pilot; no consciousness or safety proof.
